mapper.select: SELECT job.id, job.answer_id, job.question_id, job.assessment_time_id, job.user_id, job.language, job.source_code, job.testcase_type, job.custom_input, job.status, job.retry_count, job.max_retry_count, job.created_at, question.score AS question_max_score FROM tb_algorithm_judge_job job JOIN tb_assessment_question question ON question.id = job.question_id WHERE job.id = #{jobId}

SELECT job.id, job.answer_id, job.question_id, job.assessment_time_id, job.user_id, job.language, job.source_code, job.testcase_type, job.custom_input, job.status, job.retry_count, job.max_retry_count, job.created_at, question.score AS question_max_score FROM tb_algorithm_judge_job job JOIN tb_assessment_question question ON question.id = job.question_id WHERE job.id = #{jobId} AND job.testcase_type = 'FORMAL'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_algorithm_judge_job SET status = 'RUNNING', status_message = '正在判题', started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{jobId}
UPDATE tb_algorithm_judge_job SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', status_message = '判题完成', finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{jobId}
UPDATE tb_algorithm_judge_job SET status = 'FAILED_REVIEW_REQUIRED', status_message = #{message}, finished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{jobId}
